description: Side or bottom panel for content and actions related to the current context.

howToUse: Use it for details or editing that people do while keeping the page in sight: the record of a table row, filters, a cart.
Choose `side`: `right` for details, `left` for navigation, `bottom` on mobile, `full` for a screen of its own.
By default the page behind is blocked. Set `modal={false}` when people need to keep using it.
Put the actions in `footer`, which stays fixed while the content scrolls.
alternatives: A short task that interrupts everything: Modal.
A few controls attached to a button: Popover.

keyboard.action: With `modal`, moves only inside the panel. Without it, the page behind joins the order.
Closes the panel and returns focus to where it was.

props.name: modal
props.description: Visible panel (controlled; the overlay has no internal state).

props.description: Close request: Esc, scrim or the × button.

props.description: Side panel width. Ignored in bottom and full-screen panels.
